blocks.title: First electron affinity
blocks.text: The first electron affinity, delta Hea, is the enthalpy change when one mole of electrons is added to one mole of gaseous atoms to form one mole of gaseous uni-negative ions under standard conditions.

For chlorine, Cl(g) + e- gives Cl-(g), delta H = -348.8 kJ per mol; energy is released, so the first electron affinity carries a negative sign. A detailed discussion of electron affinity is given in chapter 1.
